briefdescription.para: Sizing and fast-path toggle for the database request executor.

detaileddescription.para: workers defaults to the same value as DatabaseConfig::max_conn (one worker per connection); it can be overridden with DB_WORKERS. At queue_max waiting requests, new submissions are refused with HTTP 503. The optional io_fast_path attempts requests on the IO thread first, which only helps when many requests are rejected without ever issuing a query.
